⚠ THE source_sha256 VALUES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS AND WILL BE REFUSED.
Retain each document as a source_artifact first, then replace each placeholder
with that artifact's real sha256. The tool refuses anything that is not a
64-character hex hash, and refuses any hash it cannot find in source_artifacts.
A fact may not be established from a document Spine does not hold.
ONE RETAINED ARTIFACT SUPPORTS EACH WHOLE ROW. Where facts genuinely come from
different documents they are different rows — never one row assembled from
several documents with whichever artifact id was convenient.
THREE DOCUMENTS, NOT FOUR. The org chart is not referenced: the Loan Agreement
inside the closing binder defines Borrower, so nothing here depends on the org
chart and the tool does not demand it.
WHY THE SCHEDULE CARRIES INSTRUMENT AND TERMS. Lument's amortization schedule
states loan number, loan amount, first payment, maturity, rate and interest
basis on one page — it supports those whole rows by itself. The closing binder
is the higher authority for terms but was reviewed structurally rather than
extracted, so citing it for figures it was not read for would be a provenance
claim nobody can walk back.
origination_date is deliberately ABSENT. The schedule states first payment, not
origination, and no retained document read so far establishes it. Unknown stays
unknown rather than being borrowed from another document.
